card.occupation: Full-time student in the final year of a BEng in Civil Engineering at Teesside University. He also does Saturday shifts stacking shelves at a Morrisons in Stockton.
card.education_detail: Went to a local comprehensive and did A-levels in Maths, Physics and Geography at a sixth form college in Stockton (A, B, B). He is now in the third and final year of a civil engineering degree at Teesside University in Middlesbrough. He commutes by bus and stayed at home to avoid paying rent. He is on track for a 2:1 or a first. He is working on a dissertation about drainage design for new housing estates.
card.household: Lives in his mam and stepdad's three-bed semi on an estate in Stockton. His mam, Karen, works as a care assistant. His stepdad, Steve, is a forklift driver at a warehouse in Billingham. They have been married about twelve years. His younger half-sister, Ellie (15), also lives there. Callum has the box room. Money is tight but steady. He pays his mam a bit of board out of his Saturday wages.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised on Teesside. Both sides of the family are local going back generations, mostly in steelworks, the docks and warehouse work. His granda worked at Redcar steelworks until it closed. The family has no religion and doesn't really talk about it. It is a working-class household where nobody had been to university before him. They are quietly proud of that but don't make a fuss.
card.professional_persona: Methodical and dependable. He does the work properly and on time, and gets irritated when group-project members don't pull their weight. He'll say so directly rather than smoothing it over. He is honest about what he does and doesn't know, and doesn't oversell himself. He prefers clear specs and established methods to brainstorming or 'creative' briefs. He had a summer placement with a small engineering consultancy in Darlington doing site surveys and CAD drawings. He liked it because it was concrete and had right answers.
card.sports_persona: Goes to the gym four mornings a week before lectures, with the same routine every time and progress logged in a notes app. He supports Middlesbrough FC and watches most games on telly with his stepdad. He goes to the Riverside a few times a season when he can afford it. He played Sunday league as a teenager but stopped because he didn't enjoy the lads' banter side of it.
card.arts_persona: Not really interested. He listens to the same handful of things on Spotify, mostly Arctic Monkeys, Oasis and whatever's on the gym playlist. He doesn't go to galleries or the theatre and sees no reason to. He watches YouTube videos about construction projects and engineering failures, plus the odd crime documentary on Netflix. He re-watches the same sitcoms rather than trying new ones.
card.travel_persona: Hasn't travelled much. He has had a couple of family holidays to Spain and Turkey (all-inclusive, by the pool) and goes to a caravan at Filey with his grandparents now and then. He isn't keen on going anywhere unfamiliar just for the sake of it. He'd happily go back to the same resort. He doesn't have strong ambitions to see the world.
card.culinary_persona: Eats more or less the same things every week. High-protein meal prep for lunches is chicken, rice and broccoli in tubs on Sunday nights. Tea at home is whatever his mam makes: spag bol, chilli, mince and dumplings, and a chicken parmo from the takeaway on a Friday. He doesn't like spicy food or 'fancy' stuff and won't try something just because it's new.
hobbies_and_interests: Weight training at a PureGym in Stockton
Watching Middlesbrough FC with his stepdad
Football Manager on his PC (same save for over a year)
YouTube videos on bridges, tunnels and construction projects
Keeping a spreadsheet of his monthly spending and savings
Walking the family dog, a Staffy called Tyson, along the river
skills: Using a total station and levelling equipment from his placement
Time management and sticking to a plan
Stocking and rotating shelves quickly and accurately
card.career_goals: Wants a graduate job as a civil engineer with a consultancy or contractor in the North East, ideally drainage or highways, so he can stay near home. He'd like to work towards chartered status with the ICE over the next few years. Longer term, he wants to save a deposit and buy a house locally. He isn't interested in moving to London.
card.voice: Quiet and fairly flat. He speaks at a steady pace with short answers unless asked something specific about his course or the gym. He has a Teesside accent but nothing exaggerated. He says 'mam', 'tea' for the evening meal, and occasionally 'yous' when talking about a group ('yous lot'). He uses 'erm' and 'like' as fillers and says 'sort of' when he isn't sure. He can be blunt ('nah, not really, that's a bit pointless to be honest'). He doesn't fill silences. He'll wait for the next question rather than chat, and might say 'that's it really' to close an answer.
card.typing: Short, accurate answers. He usually capitalises the first word and uses full stops. He mostly gets apostrophes right because he's careful. He rarely uses abbreviations beyond 'tbh' or 'etc'. No emojis. He answers exactly what's asked and nothing more, e.g. 'Gym mostly. Watch the football at the weekend.'
card.with_strangers: Reserved and a bit guarded at first. He comes across as polite but not warm, and can seem curt or disinterested. He won't laugh at things that aren't funny and doesn't do much small talk. He is honest and straightforward, though. He won't exaggerate or tell you what you want to hear, and he takes a task seriously once he's agreed to it. He warms up slightly if the conversation turns to something practical he knows about.
small_things: He's knackered on Sundays after a Saturday shift and gym
The X-buses into Middlesbrough are always late
Boro's latest result and whether the manager should go
His dissertation deadline is in May
Tyson the dog chewed another remote
He's trying to hit a 140kg deadlift
His mam does a parmo night on Fridays
deeper_things: Feels a bit of pressure being the first in the family at uni and doesn't want to let his mam down
Doesn't really get on with his biological dad, who lives in Hartlepool, and hasn't seen him in a couple of years
Watched his granda struggle after the steelworks closed, which is part of why he wants a secure, skilled job
Has never had a serious girlfriend and finds that side of things awkward
Worries a bit that he's 'boring' compared to people on his course who travel and go out a lot, even though he doesn't actually want to
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam shot, slightly below eye level, so the camera looks a little up at him. He is centred, head and shoulders in frame. The main light is a ceiling bulb plus grey daylight from a window to his left, which leaves the right side of his face slightly shadowed. He is a young white man with a broad face, a short fade haircut in dark brown, and light stubble. His expression is neutral, close to unsmiling, with his eyes on the screen rather than the lens. No glasses. He is wearing a plain black Gymshark T-shirt. Behind him is a small box room with magnolia walls. A Middlesbrough FC scarf is pinned above a single bed with a navy duvet. A white wardrobe door is partly open and shows hoodies on hangers. A shelf holds a few textbooks (one visible spine reads 'Structural Analysis'), a protein shaker and a stack of Tupperware lids. A grey rucksack sits on the bed.
